##### Project general facts

Al Aamra 3 Tower by GJ Properties is a thoughtfully designed residential development offering spacious 2-bedroom apartments. With smart layouts, generous spaces, natural lighting, and contemporary architecture, the project creates an elegant and comfortable living environment designed around modern family life.

Residents can enjoy premium amenities including a fully equipped health club and a spacious swimming pool, creating excellent opportunities for fitness, relaxation, and everyday enjoyment. Multi-storey parking and 24-hour security further enhance the convenience, comfort, and peace of mind of residents.

The apartments are designed with quality finishes and a modern approach that combines functionality with contemporary elegance. Beautiful natural lighting, efficient layouts, and carefully planned interiors create bright, welcoming homes with a refined and comfortable atmosphere.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman strategically positioned between other emirates, it shares a border with Sharjah and lies just 10 km from Dubai, offering convenient connectivity across the country. With its year-round sunshine, peaceful beaches, unspoiled natural landscapes, and ancient mangroves, Ajman provides a serene escape from the fast pace of modern life. Its blend of rich traditions, authentic culture, and modern infrastructure creates a truly distinctive living experience.

Ajman's growing appeal and commitment to sustainable development continue to attract investors eager to explore its promising business landscape. The establishment of the Ajman Free Zone and investor visa reforms have boosted confidence among foreign investors, injecting more liquidity into the local economy. 

UAE regulations offering pathways to citizenship and a more welcoming environment for expatriates further position Ajman as a thriving destination for living and business. Thanks to its steady development and cultural heritage, Ajman offers a calming yet luxurious atmosphere. This unique combination gives it an edge over other emirates, making it especially attractive for those seeking comfort, elegance, and peace in one place.
